Title: Influence of polystyrene microplastics on rotifer (Brachionus calyciflorus) growth, reproduction, and antioxidant responses
Classification_note: Independent units are clear for each assay, but biomarker and apical endpoints were measured in separate cohorts at different times; no figure values were visually estimated.

Title: Comparative impacts of fragmented versus spherical microplastics on the marine rotifer Brachionus koreanus: Multigenerational chronic toxicity and multi-omics perspective
Population_basis: Time to first egg; time to first reproduction; fecundity; lifespan; population-relevant multigeneration toxicity
Classification_note: PP is used only for fragments and PE only for beads, so the claimed shape contrast cannot be separated from polymer. Omics and chronic life-history tests are separate experiments.

Title: Changes in life-history traits, antioxidant defense, energy metabolism and molecular outcomes in the cladoceran Daphnia pulex after exposure to polystyrene microplastics
Population_basis: Survival/lifespan; body length; reproduction; population growth
Classification_note: Independent units are beakers, not the plotted number of sampled organisms. Life-history and biomarker cohorts were separate, so mechanistic-apical linkage is cohort-level.

Title: Alleviation of Tris(2-chloroethyl) Phosphate Toxicity on the Marine Rotifer Brachionus plicatilis by Polystyrene Microplastics: Features and Molecular Evidence
Classification_note: Particle-only and TCEP co-exposure strata must remain separate. The n=12 figure notation reflects organisms per condition, whereas the independent experimental-unit count is three wells.

Title: The thermal regime modifies the response of aquatic keystone species Daphnia to microplastics: Evidence from population fitness, accumulation, histopathological analysis and candidate gene expression
Population_basis: Longevity/survival; net reproduction; intrinsic population growth
Classification_note: Temperature is an effect modifier, not a contaminant. Within-temperature particle contrasts are primary, but no variance-complete arm means are printed.

Title: Microplastic Size-Dependent Toxicity, Oxidative Stress Induction, and p-JNK and p-p38 Activation in the Monogonont Rotifer (Brachionus koreanus)
Population_basis: Population growth; fecundity; lifespan; reproduction time

Title: Intergenerational and biological effects of roxithromycin and polystyrene microplastics to Daphnia magna
Population_basis: Survival; offspring number; first-brood timing; intrinsic population-growth rate
Classification_note: Ten one-animal beakers provide clear chronic replication. Most plots report SEM, while the statistical section ambiguously states mean ± SD (Standard Error of mean) and Fig. 9 reports SD. No plotted value was visually estimated.

Title: Impacts and transport of microplastics: Population dynamics in frogs and the transfer between aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems
Population_basis: Hatching; larval survival; metamorphosis; modeled population size, lambda and extinction risk
Classification_note: This is a rare population-level study, but the extreme log-rank statistic suggests individual eggs were treated as independent despite nine clutch/tank replicates. Population and cross-ecosystem effects are simulation outputs rather than direct field observations.

Title: Size over substance: Microplastic particle size drives gene expression and fitness loss in a freshwater insect
Population_basis: Mortality; emergence time; fertility; daily population growth rate
Classification_note: All adults from five bowls were combined into one reproduction cage per treatment, limiting independence for fertility and PGR despite bowl-level larval replication.

Title: Microplastics influence physiological processes, growth and reproduction in the Manila clam, Ruditapes philippinarum
Population_basis: Growth and reproduction, including DEB-model projections
